title: Lead US IT Recuiter
description:
Grey Parrot Systems is a women-owned, BEP-certified IT services firm headquartered in Naperville, IL. We deliver AI-first, governance-driven digital transformation for mid-market enterprises — and we're growing.

**About the Role**

This is a full-cycle recruiting role focused on IT staffing for US clients. You will own requisitions end-to-end — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and presenting candidates — while using our AI-powered matching tools to move faster without sacrificing quality. You'll work closely with Business Development Managers and clients to understand technical role requirements and deliver a strong, compliant candidate pipeline across a range of IT skill sets.

Must-Have Skills

* 8+ years of full-cycle US IT recruiting experience, ideally supporting staffing or professional services clients
* Strong sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, Dice, Monster, and other IT-focused job boards
* Ability to read and evaluate technical resumes across roles like developers, QA, DevOps, cloud, and data engineers
* Understanding of common tech stacks, certifications, and IT hiring terminology
* Excellent written and verbal English — comfortable interviewing and presenting candidates to US clients
* Experience using AI-powered sourcing or matching tools to accelerate recruiting workflows
* Proficiency with ATS/CRM tools for tracking candidates and requisitions
* Familiarity with US work authorization types (W2, C2C, 1099) and basic visa/immigration terminology
* Comfortable working US-aligned business hours for overlap with clients and hiring managers
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple open requisitions at once

**What You'll Do**

* Manage full-cycle recruiting for IT roles across assigned US client accounts
* Source and screen candidates using job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and AI-powered tools
* Conduct technical screening calls to assess skills, experience, and fit against client requirements
* Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview-to-offer process
* Negotiate rates and manage submissions for W2, C2C, and 1099 engagements as applicable
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate and requisition records in the ATS/CRM
* Partner with Business Development Managers to understand new client needs and role specs
* Track requisition aging, time-to-fill, and pipeline health, flagging risks early
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for recurring or high-demand IT skill sets

Tools You'll Use LinkedIn Recruiter · Dice · Monster · CareerBuilder · AI-Powered Sourcing Tools · ATS/CRM (Salesforce / Bullhorn / Zoho / JobDiva) · Microsoft 365 · Google Workspace

Target Skill Areas Software Development · Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) · Data & Analytics · Cybersecurity · DevOps · QA/Testing · IT Support & Helpdesk · ERP (Salesforce, SAP, etc.)

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience recruiting for a US IT staffing firm or professional services business
* Familiarity with VMS platforms (Beeline, Fieldglass, or similar)
* Experience with rate negotiation and C2C vendor management
* Bachelor's degree in Business, HR, or a related field
* Knowledge of US tech hiring trends and in-demand skill sets

**Details**

* Location: India — Remote (US-aligned working hours)
* Experience: 8+ years
* Type: Full-Time
* Start: Immediate

**Stay Connected**

👉 https://www.linkedin.com/company/gparrot/

title: Product Implementation & Support Engineer
description:
*Experience: 1+ Years*
*Location : Remote*
Qualification : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics
  
  
Shift : 09:30 AM to 6:30 PM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Product Implementation & Support Executive to assist clients with the
  
  
implementation, configuration, adoption, and ongoing support of SkizzleHR, our HRMS platform. The candidate will work closely
  
  
with clients to understand their requirements, guide them through the product, and resolve their queries efficiently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in implementing and onboarding new clients onto the SkizzleHR platform.
* Coordinate with clients to collect employee data, organizational structure details, and other implementation prerequisites.
* Configure and guide clients on HRMS modules, including Core HR, Attendance, Leave Management, Payroll, and other applicable modules.
* Conduct online product demonstrations, training sessions, and client walkthroughs.
* Provide support through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and online meetings.
* Troubleshoot client queries related to attendance, leave, employee records, payrollprocessing, and portal usage.
* Track client issues, follow up on pending queries, and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain documentation of client communications, implementation progress, and support activities.
* Coordinate with internal technical and product teams to resolve bugs and complex issues.
* Help clients adopt the platform effectively and maintain a positive customer experience.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in product implementation, software support, customer support, or a similar role.
* Experience with HRMS, HR software, payroll software, or SaaS products is preferred.
* Good understanding of HR operations, attendance, leave management, and basic payroll concepts.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in Hindi and English.
* Good problem-solving, client-handling, and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable working with Excel, online meetings, and web-based software applications.
* Willingness to learn product functionality and manage multiple client requests.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Experience with HRMS companies or platforms such as Keka, greytHR, Saral PayPack, or similar solutions.
* Customer-focused, proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with implementation, support, product, and technical teams. sharing product knowledge with team members

title: Dispatch Associate (URGENT HIRING)
description:
About the job
 



  





 Whiz Delivery is a Canadian last\-mile delivery company operating in Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, and Alberta. We take pride in handling every order with speed, precision, and care. We are seeking a
 **Dispatch Associate to join us immediately** 
 , helping us maintain efficiency, communicate effectively, and take ownership of their role.
 



  





 If you are
 **proactive, observant, resourceful, capable of working under minimal supervision, and have good presence of min** 
 d, this role could be your next big step. We offer the opportunity to grow professionally, acquire new skills, and assume greater responsibility over time, all while being part of an international team.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**Pickup Coordination** 



* Coordinate daily pickups to ensure they run on time and without issues.
* Track order volumes, schedule drivers, and plan efficient routes.
* Assign vehicles and follow up to ensure safety and maintenance standards are met.
* Liaise with truck rental partners when vehicles are required or issues arise.
* Monitor drivers in real time and take quick initiative to resolve delays or incidents independently.



  





**Client \& Team Communication** 



* Communicate with clients and sellers via phone and email to confirm pickup times, provide updates, and manage last\-minute changes.
* Keep internal teams informed to ensure smooth operations between pickups and deliveries.
* Maintain accurate daily records to support transparency and accountability.



  





**Process Support** 



* Keep logs, records, reports, and checklists up to date.
* Assist with delivery dispatch during peak periods.
* Actively share process improvement ideas and take ownership of implementing small improvements to enhance system speed and reliability.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–2 years of experience in dispatch or logistics coordination.
* Strong English communication skills; Hindi is an asset.
* Must have skills: Observation, Attention to Detail, Responsiveness, and Quick Action.
* Proven ability to take initiative, work independently, and make sound decisions with minimal supervision.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to stay composed in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office.
* Based in India and available during Eastern Standard Time business hours.
* Willingness to follow the Canadian work calendar and holidays, with flexibility for extended hours as needed.
* **Immediate availability to join.**



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work for a growing Canadian company making an impact in logistics.
* Take ownership of meaningful work and grow your career in an international environment.
* Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role while being part of a collaborative, supportive team.
* Be part of a culture that values initiative, accountability, and getting things done right.



  





**Work Schedule** 



* Monday to Friday: 11 am to 8 pm EST (full\-time)
* Sunday: 12 pm to 3 pm EST (on call)



  





**Compensation** 



* ₹40,000 per month in hand.
* ₹30,000 during the first 1\-month training period.
